classification.difficultyReason: Each part requires selecting one right-triangle ratio and finding an unknown numerator side.

content.prompt: Find $x$ in each of the following figures. Give answers to two decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a vertical left side, horizontal base and descending hypotenuse.
spec.mathematics: The hypotenuse is 6; x is opposite the 38-degree angle; the bottom-left angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a horizontal top side and vertical left side.
spec.mathematics: The hypotenuse is 6; x is adjacent to the 64-degree angle at the top-right vertex; the top-left angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a vertical left side and horizontal base.
spec.mathematics: The base is 4.5, adjacent to the bottom-right 41-degree angle; x is opposite; the bottom-left angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a horizontal base, vertical right side and rising hypotenuse.
spec.mathematics: The hypotenuse is 3; x is opposite the bottom-left 41-degree angle; the bottom-right angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a vertical left side and horizontal base.
spec.mathematics: The hypotenuse is 6; the base x is adjacent to the bottom-right 64-degree angle; the bottom-left angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a horizontal top side, vertical right side and descending hypotenuse.
spec.mathematics: The top side 2.3 is adjacent to the top-left 35-degree angle; x is opposite; the top-right angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a horizontal top side and vertical left side.
spec.mathematics: The hypotenuse is 4.1; x is adjacent to the top-right 32-degree angle; the top-left angle is right.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with a vertical left side and horizontal base.
spec.mathematics: The base 3.9 is adjacent to the bottom-right 73-degree angle; x is opposite; the bottom-left angle is right.
